bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the emotion annotation alignment (measured via F1 score, precision, recall, and Cohen's kappa) of 'in-group' human annotators (who share the author's age, gender, and race) versus 'out-group' annotators (who differ on at least two of those traits) against self-reported first-party labels. It also evaluates LLM annotation performance with and without explicitly incorporating the author's demographic information into the prompt.
